cases.finding: Finding: The October Crossref direct-API record for DOI 10.1088/2515-7620/aeaad2 includes primary award NA24OARX459C0015, independently corroborated by the NOAA Institutional Repository and the article's own Funding section. Exact DOI/title screening found no match in the full REACH index or Scout feed; targeted alternate index links did not match, but all secondary details and possible versions have not been exhausted.
